goal: Reuse existing GDL/LibraryPart functionality without duplicate native writer or interfering with concurrent Work

capture.saved_schema_origin: live TapirCommand.GenerateDocumentation in a previously recorded test PLN

evidence.finding: Historic plan proposes HSF/GDL -> LP_XMLConverter -> library catalog -> Tapir load/place/readback. This is not current runtime proof.

Saved Tapir 1.5.10 export already defines SafeBIMGlobalLibraryPart and CreateLibraryPartFromScripts with Inspect/Register/Compile/Discover plus nonmutating AuditWindows/AuditDoors actions; expectedProjectPath mandatory. Implementation and availability in currently loaded APX NOT_VERIFIED.

ObjectDetails.libPart uses LibPartDetails with name, parentUnID, ownUnID; this supplies a typed post-placement identity readback contract. GetGDLParametersOfElements also exists for typed GDL parameters. Actual runtime behavior NOT_VERIFIED.

CreateObjects items require libraryPartName plus coordinates; there is no create-item argument for Main GUID. The write must be gated by same native name resolver identity, not only inventory name match.

GetAvailableLibraryParts returns guid/index/documentName and skippedCount, skippedSample; 92 historical unreadable parts on previous test are not assumed current. Native resolver diagnostic patch exists, but installation/live invocation not demonstrated.
Existing project library pack compiler is deliberately read-only, resolves one exact BuildingMaterial GUID, sets importedLibraryObjects=[], and does not import GDL/PLA or run AddLibraries.

AddLibraries, SetLibraries, ReloadLibraries, AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary and SetGDLParametersOfElements are exposed write-capable commands and must not be called by read-only inspection or hidden side effects.
New AC29 projects prefer Global Library and linked reusable SBIM libraries; do not preload legacy monolith catalogs or silently substitute missing library parts.

reconciler_gates: Exact installed AC29/Tapir/APX and source implementation identity; schema snapshot alone is not a live gate
Read-only exact project identity and library enumeration before any possible artifact/register/compile step
Resolve libraryPartName via same native ACAPI_LibraryPart_Search flags used by CreateObjects and prove expected Main GUID; failed/partial inventory must be handled fail-closed
Separate explicit user approval for external file generation, AddLibraries/ReloadLibraries, and any native create/write. No transparent conversion of read-only into file/PLN mutation

After single separately approved CreateObjects operation, verify returned element GUID, ObjectDetails.libPart.ownUnID, and GetGDLParametersOfElements actual saved parameters; unknown outcome -> no blind retry
Only then conditionally extend Project Library Pack with content/version/right records while leaving native Wall/Slab/Roof operations native
